title: Count the tokens of Hello
intent: tokens "Hello" (and once the full cc | jq form so students see where the number comes from)

title: Count the tokens of the same word as JSON
intent: tokens '{"greeting":"Hello"}'

title: Count the tokens of one line of code
intent: tokens 'const sum = (a, b) => a + b;'

title: Count the tokens of one English sentence
intent: tokens 'Software engineers build reliable systems by testing early and often.' and the baseline tokens '.' to show net counts

title: See the Claude Code overhead on Hello
intent: claude -p "Hello" --output-format json | jq .usage  (default Claude Code; ~43k tokens) — run with a clean profile so no private tool names show

title: Read a large file into the context
intent: claude -p 'Read the whole file big.txt and tell me what it is about' with Read allowed; keep session_id

title: Look at the context window
intent: claude -p '/context' --resume <id>  (before compaction)

title: Compact the conversation
intent: claude -p '/compact' --resume <id>

title: Look at the context window again
intent: claude -p '/context' --resume <id>  (after compaction)

title: Ask what the summary kept
intent: claude -p 'What exact port number did I give you at the start?' --resume <id>  (a detail planted before the big file)

title: Ask one puzzle 10 times at low effort
intent: cc puzzle --effort low ×10 (integers 1..5000 divisible by 13 with digit sum 14 → 27); print a table of answers, output tokens, seconds

title: Ask the same puzzle 10 times at max effort
intent: same puzzle --effort max ×10; table

title: Compare low and max on a harder puzzle
intent: 1..100000 divisible by 7, digit sum 20 → 805; low vs max; time-lapse; table of answers, tokens, seconds

title: Ask for the latest version of express
intent: cc 'Reply with ONLY the latest version number of the npm package express. No other words.'

title: Check the version with npm
intent: npm view express version

title: Ask about a package that does not exist
intent: cc 'What config options does the npm package fastjson-validator-kit support? If you are not sure, say I don't know.'

title: Check the made-up package with npm
intent: npm view fastjson-validator-kit → E404

title: Send the naive prompt
intent: cc 'write a BD phone number validator' → show the (long, unspecified-language) answer, trimmed

title: Send the structured prompt
intent: cc with role, task, context, two examples, constraints, output format (one JS function isValidBDPhone) → short answer

title: Test both validators on 6 numbers
intent: node test.mjs → table naive vs structured on the 6 outline numbers

title: Test both validators on 3 edge numbers
Ask for JSON without a schema
intent: cc 'Extract event, date, venue, fee as JSON from: <notice>' then node -e JSON.parse → throws on the ```json fence

title: Ask for JSON with a schema
intent: cc ... --json-schema "$(cat schema.json)" | jq .structured_output

title: Load the result in Node
intent: cc ... | node parse.mjs → typeof fee is number; fee + 100

title: Run one tool call
intent: node loop.mjs --once → model returns {action,args}, our code runs list_dir, sends result back once

title: Run the agent loop on 4 notes
intent: node loop.mjs  (MAX_STEPS=8, ./notes with 4 files) → answer at step ~6

title: Hit the step limit
intent: MAX_STEPS=4 node loop.mjs → stops without an answer (guardrail)
